items.text: I follow steps, one at a time, in order. Your steps get me to the flower.

items.prompt: Tap a step to get me to the flower.
items.explain: One step right and I'm there.

items.prompt: Three steps this time. I start as soon as the last one is in.
items.explain: Right, right, right: three steps along the row.

items.prompt: The flower is up a row. Build the steps.
items.explain: Three steps right and one up. Up first works too: there's more than one way.

items.prompt: Read my steps. Tap the square where I stop.
items.explain: Right, right, then down: two along and one down.

items.text: Rocks are in the way. I can't walk through them, so the steps go around.

items.prompt: Get me round the rock to the flower.
items.explain: Down, right, right, up: under the rock and back up.

items.prompt: A taller rock. Six steps.
items.explain: Down twice, right twice, up twice: all the way round.

items.text: Watch. The right step hits the rock, so I stop there. The down step never happens: a rock, or the edge of the grid, ends the run.

items.prompt: A rock is on my way. Tap where I stop.
items.explain: One step right, then the rock blocks the next one, so I stop there. A step into a rock ends the run.

items.text: A repeat block does what's inside it again and again. Repeat 4 times → is the same as → → → →, with less tapping.

items.prompt: How many times should I step right?
items.explain: Four squares to the flower, so repeat 4 times.

items.prompt: The count is set. Pick the step to repeat.
items.explain: Right, five times over.

items.text: Watch. With two steps inside, I do them in order, then go back to the top and do both again.

items.prompt: Stairs! Two steps inside, done three times.
items.explain: Right then up, three times: a staircase. Up first runs into a rock.

items.prompt: Read the loop. Tap where I stop.
items.explain: Right and down, twice over: two along and two down.

items.prompt: A long way. How many times?
items.explain: Six squares, so repeat 6 times. Counting the gaps is the trick.

items.prompt: One loop goes right, the next goes down. Set both counts.
items.explain: Right 3 times, then down 2 times. One loop finishes before the next one starts.

items.prompt: A loop, then one more step. Tap where I stop.
items.explain: Three steps right, then the loop is done and I step up once.

items.text: An if block looks at the very next square. If there's a rock right beside me on my right, I do the first step. Else, meaning no rock there, I do the other one.
Watch. In a repeat, I look again each time round. Rock beside me, so up. Then no rock, so right, and right again.

items.prompt: Rock to my right: which way? No rock: which way?
items.explain: If a rock is to my right, step up. Else, step right. The same two blocks climb any rocks like these.

items.prompt: Now I'm going down. Rock below me: which way? No rock: which way?
items.explain: If a rock is below me, step right. Else, step down.

items.prompt: Follow the if each time round. Tap where I stop.
items.explain: A rock to my right, so down. Then no rock, so right, and right again.

items.prompt: The if is ready. How many times round?
items.explain: Right, right, then rocks, so up, up: 4 times round.

items.prompt: Going up. Rock above me: which way? No rock: which way?
items.explain: If a rock is above me, step right. Else, step up.

items.prompt: One last read. Tap where I stop.
items.explain: Right, then a rock, so down. Then right and right again.
